name: ptyper2-par1-typer
description: What the parallel driver on one worker costs against the serial compile of the same build, compiles stopped after the typer, paired within each fork. `aa` is `spike` again: the noise floor. xctrace counts the benchmark thread only, so a `-Yparallel-typer` variant's counters miss its worker thread: compare those by time.

variantDescriptions.spike: the parallel typer spike at `3c72e64ddf`, without `-Yparallel-typer`
variantDescriptions.aa: the first variant's build again, in its own class loader: the A/A
variantDescriptions.fix: `spike` plus the overhead fixes (branch `ptyper-overhead-fixes` at `f772eb69a6`), without the flag
